hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Start with just the second part. What do you get when you expand $2(x + 4)$?
The parentheses are in the way. Remove them first, then look for terms that are alike.
Distribute the $2$ to turn the expression into $3x + 2x + 8$. Now combine the two $x$ terms.

explanation: Distribute the $2$ over the parentheses first: $2(x + 4) = 2x + 8$.
Rewrite the whole expression without parentheses: $3x + 2x + 8$.
Combine the like terms $3x$ and $2x$ by adding coefficients: $5x$.
The $8$ has no partner, so the answer is $5x + 8$.
